editorial.blurb: Zenwich brings its cult-favorite Asian-style sandwiches to Edgewater with the same focus on quality ingredients and genuine hospitality that made the original a neighborhood treasure.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the house-made chips as a side—reviewers consistently single them out—and don't skip the Spicy Garlic Shrimp if you like heat; it's a loyal repeat order at the original location.

topDishes.note: Fresh, perfectly balanced, beloved by multiple reviewers
